messages.content:
You extract business relations from excerpts of Citigroup Inc.'s annual report (10-K, Item 1 Business).
Each excerpt starts with [p.N] = its PDF page.

Return JSON: {"relations": [{"type": ..., "entity": ..., "quote": ..., "page": N}]}
type is one of:
  "competitor"  - a company Citigroup Inc. names as a competitor
  "supplier"    - a company that manufactures for / supplies Citigroup Inc. (foundry, contract manufacturer, key supplier)
  "customer"    - a named customer that is significant to Citigroup Inc. (e.g. accounts for a % of revenue)
  "segment"     - a reportable/operating segment of Citigroup Inc. (entity = segment name)
  "acquisition" - a company Citigroup Inc. acquired or agreed to acquire
Rules:
- entity must be a specific organization (or segment) NAMED in the text, never a category like "cloud providers".
- quote must be copied EXACTLY from the excerpt (8-30 words) and must contain the entity name.
- page is the [p.N] of the excerpt the quote comes from.
- list each (type, entity) once. If nothing qualifies, return {"relations": []}.

EXCERPTS:
[p.12] Citi is modernizing and 2026 and beyond, Citi expects them to decline over time. simplifying the Company in order to lead in a dynamic, competitive and digital world.
